summary: This Dockerfile creates a lightweight Python container that runs a FastAPI web application. It starts with a minimal Python image, installs FastAPI, copies your application code into the container, and configures it to run on port 82.

explanations.2: The `slim` variant is a stripped-down version of Python that's much smaller than the standard image, which saves disk space and download time while still having everything needed to run Python code.
explanations.5: WORKDIR sets the working directory inside the container to /app, so any commands that follow will run from that location and files will be organized there.
explanations.8: The `--no-cache-dir` flag tells pip not to store downloaded packages in a cache folder, which saves space in the final image since we won't need them again after installation.
explanations.11: This copies your local `main.py` file from your computer into the container at the path `/app/main.py` so the container has your application code to run.
